title: Board Declaration of the Quarterly Dividend on Class H Preferred Stock — Member Equities & Patronage
content:
The board of Cottonwood Plains Farm Credit declares the dividend on Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock quarter by quarter. The board's current declaration covers the quarter from 1 April 2026 to 30 June 2026, 91 days, paid on 15 July 2026.

## The dividend declared

The quarterly preferred dividend equals the dividend share basis times the dividend annual rate, divided by 100, times the days in the declared quarter, divided by 365, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure only.

- **Dividend share basis.** The shares the holding carried at the end of the declared quarter, that is the holding's purchases plus its reinvested dividends less its retirements, at par of 1.00 per share.
- **Dividend annual rate.** The declared annual dividend rate of Class H Preferred Stock, per year, as shown in the class schedule of dividend terms.
- **Days in the declared quarter.** 91 for the quarter from 1 April 2026 to 30 June 2026.
- **Rounding.** One rounding, half up to the cent, on the dividend itself; neither the basis nor any intermediate product is rounded.

## The declaration in figures

| Item | Declared |
|---|---|
| Quarter | 1 April 2026 to 30 June 2026 |
| Days in the quarter | 91 |
| Payment date | 15 July 2026 |
| Day-count divisor | 365 |

## Worked figure (hypothetical holding)

A Class H Preferred Stock holding shows purchases of USD 60,000.00, reinvested dividends of USD 2,400.00 and retirements of USD 1,000.00.

1. Dividend share basis: 60,000.00 plus 2,400.00 less 1,000.00 gives 61,400.00 shares.
2. Multiplied by the declared annual rate of the class (4.25 percent in the current class schedule) and divided by 100: 2,609.50.
3. Multiplied by the 91 days of the quarter and divided by 365: 650.5876…
4. Rounded half up to the cent, once: USD 650.59, the dividend for the quarter paid on 15 July 2026.
